title: BCYT's Extra Vanilla Recipes
description: This datapack adds missing recipes! (NOTE: SIMMILAR TO MYSTICAT'S EXTRA RECIPES)
body:
This datapack adds missing vanilla recipes that people wanted (NOTE: SIMMILAR TO MYSTICAT'S EXTRA RECIPES) I added the same things but no spawn eggs, Has exactly 69 recipes (we are planning to add more in the future), there are also reworked recipes that are similar to mysticat's ones and also I removed some recipes to keep things fair and balanced, I added even more recipes that mysticat didn't add. this datapack makes some OP items craftable like spawners and end portal frames, also craftable heads(including dragon heads, player head and piglin heads), this can make the game much better and fun for minecraft

                               WHAT DOES THIS ADD?

Better recipes, not just for crafting, but..... For smelting too! this adds a variety of things to the recipes so you don't have to loot a hard ocean monument just for getting sponges..

hope you enjoy!
